messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T

Straight up: the H15 Dual hasn't dropped yet — it's not buyable today, and the drop date hasn't been announced.

What is live is the B30 at $899 (30 TH/s, ~360-450W) and the Magic Miner 40T at $799 (40 TH/s, ~650W). Under 12¢ those both stack real sats.

Where are you mining from? Give me the state or country and I'll run the actual numbers for you.
Searched the catalog · Dogecoin Litecoin scrypt miner

Since the H15 isn't buyable, the clean way to get both is two boxes.

Bitcoin side: Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at ~650W. Best value per TH we sell. At 12¢ that's roughly $56/month in power. Ships November 14, 2026.

Doge side: Hammer DC06, $379.99, 330 MH/s at ~105W — about $9/month, and it's in stock now.

Honest framing: at retail power this is stacking sats plus a real solo-block lottery shot, not net profit today.

What's your budget for the pair?
How much can I make all of the running the device？

Straight answer: at home power, these don't out-earn the bill. Your cost for the pair is about $65 a month at 12¢.

Pointed at a pool, 40 TH/s against the whole network earns a small trickle of sats — well under that $65. Solo, you earn nothing until you hit a block, and then it's the full reward. That's the real draw: cheap sats plus a lottery ticket that runs 24/7.

Anyone selling you steady profit on a home miner is lying.

Still worth it to you?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the + Dogecoin numbers for where you live.
